title: ContextLens Technical Clip-Art Set
purpose: Support the ContextLens slide deck with a coherent visual vocabulary for historical place resolution, ambiguity, evidence auditing, scope, and the relationship to StableTradeAtlas.

source.title: ContextLens: An Evidence-Grounded Agent for Verifiable Historical Address Investigation

target_figure.placement: One compact semantic illustration on each selected text-heavy slide; one larger hero illustration on the acknowledgment slide

evidence_boundary: These assets are conceptual illustrations. They do not encode measured values, empirical results, causal effects, certification, implementation status, or a claim that ContextLens was developed within StableTradeAtlas.

art_direction.viewpoint: front orthographic with restrained depth cues
art_direction.outline: 2 px equivalent, dark navy, round caps and joins
art_direction.lighting: flat scientific illustration with no cast shadow
art_direction.detail_level: medium-low for legibility at slide-icon size
